verdict.rationale: The pack documents no merchant-facing controls to rate-limit, allow-list, or deny specific agents or agent platforms for catalog or checkout access. The closest items are adjacent: the Feed API lets a merchant choose which AI platforms receive product data, and the marketing page says merchants stay "fully in control." Neither is access control or throttling, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents and agent platforms accessing my catalog and checkout
